verdict.rationale: Batch mode documents creating a job via POST /aiservices/scribe/jobs and polling a get-status endpoint. Jobs move through documented states (QUEUED, PROCESSING, SUCCEEDED, PARTIAL, FAILED, CANCELED), with per-file states, file counts and result locations, and the OpenAPI probe confirms the status and per-file paths. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the polling workflow.
